newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll takes majority of DASA unit.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll takes majority of DASA unit.

text.p: Von Roll Holding AG said its Von Roll Inova unit had acquired the majority of MBB Recycling GmbH, a subsidiary of Daimler-Benz Aerospace (DASA), part of Germany's Daimler-Benz AG group.
The company, which will be known as Von Roll MBB Recycling GmbH (VR-MBB), performs environmentally sound recycling of electrical and electronic equipment, Von Roll said in a statement.
Von Roll Inova's strategic aim is to expand these activities throughout Europe.
MBB Recycling was founded in 1994 and DASA decided to cooperate with Von Roll as part of DASA's efforts to focus on its core business.
